item.objective: Bind the UTS #39 confusable-key audit to exact, versioned, integrity-verified Unicode source bytes.
completed_slices: Researched the current Unicode 17 security-data location from the normative UTS #39 data-files section.
Retrieved the exact Unicode 17.0.0 confusables.txt source and retained its SHA-256, byte length, version header, data date, and MA record count.
Implemented a fail-closed source verifier that rejects mutable latest aliases, byte drift, version drift, and record-count drift.
Verified the implementation with four deterministic Node tests.
acceptance_remaining: Independently reproduce the exact source retrieval and manifest values in an authenticated repository checkout or CI job.
Decide whether to vendor the source bytes or retain them as a separately archived build input under the Unicode terms of use.
Require source verification before parseConfusables is allowed to construct a production dataset.
Define explicit migration behavior for future Unicode versions; never replace the pinned dataset silently.
item.safe_next_action: Add an integration adapter that reads the pinned manifest, verifies downloaded or archived bytes with enforceUnicodeConfusablesSource, and only then calls parseConfusables with expectedVersion=17.0.0. Retain verification output and prohibit latest aliases.
